summary: This feature profiles four local social workers, Jane Thompson, Richard Lopez, Melissa Grant and Sarah Chen, whom the author accompanied between October 2023 and February 2024. Their work spans foster care, school counseling, addiction recovery, homelessness and family services. The piece argues that social workers quietly strengthen the community by empowering people and building resilience.
one_line: A profile of four local social workers showing how their daily work in foster care, addiction, homelessness and family services empowers the community.
key_facts: Jane Thompson is a seasoned social worker with over a decade of experience; the author met her on October 10, 2023.
Jane Thompson says "Social work is about being a stable presence in the turbulence that so many face."
Jane Thompson's first visit that day was to the Edmonds family, helping their foster child transition into their home.
At midday Jane Thompson counsels teens at the local high school on anxiety, peer pressure, identity and mental health struggles.
Richard Lopez specializes in addiction recovery; the author shadowed him on November 3, 2023.
Richard Lopez's routine can include accompanying clients to court hearings, running group therapy sessions and conducting emergency interventions.
Richard Lopez says witnessing someone take the first step toward recovery is "an indescribable feeling."
On December 15, 2023, the author accompanied Melissa Grant, who works to integrate the homeless population back into society through temporary shelters and help with job interviews.
Melissa Grant helped Anthony, a man whose life was derailed by ill health and job loss, move from despair to stability.
Sarah Chen works in family services; January 20, 2024 marked a milestone for her.
Sarah Chen says "The essence of our work is empowerment."
The author reflects on the work on February 5, 2024, concluding that social workers are anchors and compasses of community wellbeing.
The article says the social workers have dedicated themselves to the community since September 2023.
